messages:
devon: Heads-up: ap-east-1 GPU warm pools showing delayed joins starting 2026-05-12T02:14 UTC. Autoscaler backlog increasing and some jobs falling back to us-west.
mai: seeing init failures: `KMS decrypt timeout` and occasional `connection reset`. Init pods stuck at bootstrap.
trent: I merged fw-change `restrict-egress-2026-05` earlier to tighten outbound to our telemetry collectors. I thought the KMS endpoint was in the allowlist but the generated rule appears truncated.
devon: tcpdump from init container shows RST to kms.ap-east-1.amazonaws.com ranges.
infra-bot: policy apply detected: restrict-egress-2026-05 by trent at 2026-05-12T02:10:23Z.
mai: Quick mitigation: add an ephemeral egress allow (TCP 443) for KMS and STS endpoints with 15m TTL. That should let nodes decrypt and join.
trent: applying ephemeral SG patch now. Rolling back the policy in parallel.
finance: cost alert automated: estimated incremental cost while failing over to us-west ~ $2.7k/hr.
security-bot: Created finding SEC-2026-089. Short-term allowlist acceptable, long-term Privatelink recommended.
trent: patch applied. After patch, I can see successful decrypts in init logs: 
```
2026-05-12T02:17:41Z init: KMS Decrypt -> 200 OK
2026-05-12T02:17:42Z init: decrypted node identity token
2026-05-12T02:18:04Z join: node registered to pool-gpu-ape
```
devon: Warm pools draining fallback traffic; autoscaler node_join_rate back to normal.
mai: Follow-ups: 1) raise Privatelink request for KMS+STS in ap-east-1 2) add an egress smoke test to the fw pipeline that performs a KMS decrypt during canary 3) update fw PR template to require explicit KMS/ST S CIDR validation 4) add an automated lint that fails PRs missing required service ranges.
trent: I'll update the template and add the lint. Also will ensure the rollout includes a post-deploy canary job that simulates node init.
infra-bot: Revert of restrict-egress-2026-05 completed.
security-bot: Scheduling design review for Privatelink and least-privilege egress patterns next Tue.
finance: tagging for cost recovery review; please add exact start/end times to the incident.
devon: Opening INC-2026-203 and attaching tcpdumps, autoscaler graphs, and the cost estimate. Will write the playbook snippet for oncall into the incident page:
```
- check nodes: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep NotReady`
- collect init logs: `kubectl -n infra logs <init-pod> -c init`
- grep for kms errors: `grep -E "KMS|decrypt|AccessDenied" init.log`
- tcpdump to confirm RST: `tcpdump -i eth0 host kms.ap-east-1.amazonaws.com and tcp`
- mitigation: add ephemeral SG egress rule or revert fw policy
- monitor: `prometheus:autoscaler.node_join_rate` and `grafana:gpu-warmup`
```
mai: small ops note: ephemeral allowlists should auto-expire and create an audit ticket automatically. I'll add that to the follow-up tasks.
devon: Thanks all. Closing thread once INC-2026-203 has RCA and postmortem link. :white_check_mark:
